user.description: Adds the 'Set feeder schedule' action for Aqara Pet Feeder C1s paired with ZHA. There is nothing to configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Pet Feeder Scheduler is already set up.

options.utc: UTC (ZHA default): same time for your pets all year
options.local: Local: write times exactly as entered

set_schedule.name: Set feeder schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes a daily feeding schedule into the feeder's own memory, replacing its current schedule. The feeder follows it even when Home Assistant is offline.

device_id.name: Feeders
device_id.description: The Aqara Pet Feeder C1s to write this schedule to.

meal_1_time.name: Meal 1 time
meal_1_time.description: Time of the first meal, as your clock reads today.

meal_1_portions.name: Meal 1 portions
meal_1_portions.description: Portions to dispense for the first meal (1-10).

meal_2_time.name: Meal 2 time
meal_2_time.description: Time of the second meal, as your clock reads today. Leave empty for no meal.

meal_2_portions.name: Meal 2 portions
meal_2_portions.description: Portions to dispense for the second meal (1-10).

meal_3_time.name: Meal 3 time
meal_3_time.description: Time of the third meal, as your clock reads today. Leave empty for no meal.

meal_3_portions.name: Meal 3 portions
meal_3_portions.description: Portions to dispense for the third meal (1-10).

meal_4_time.name: Meal 4 time
meal_4_time.description: Time of the fourth meal, as your clock reads today. Leave empty for no meal.

meal_4_portions.name: Meal 4 portions
meal_4_portions.description: Portions to dispense for the fourth meal (1-10).

feeder_clock.name: Feeder clock
feeder_clock.description: Which clock the feeder runs on. On ZHA it runs on UTC, so meals stay at the same time of day for your pets when daylight saving time changes, and move by an hour on your clock. Choose local only if a test meal showed your feeder uses local time.

set_schedule_mode.name: Switch to schedule mode
set_schedule_mode.description: Also switch the feeder to schedule mode. It ignores its schedule in manual mode.
